patthana24.3:1.1: na hetu na sappaccayo dhammo hetussa sappaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana24.3:3.1: nahetuduka nasanidassanaduke hetuduka sanidassanadukaṃ na hetuṃ na sanidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu sanidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.3:4.1: na hetu na anidassano dhammo hetussa anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:. ārammaṇe tīṇi. nahetuduka nasappaṭighaduke hetuduka sappaṭighadukaṃ
patthana24.3:5.1: na hetuṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.3:6.1: na hetuṃ na appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. nahetudukana rūpīduke hetuduka rūpīdukaṃ
patthana24.3:7.1: na hetuṃ na rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.3:8.1: na hetuṃ na arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nalokiyaduke hetuduka lokiyadukaṃ
patthana24.3:9.1: na hetuṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na nahetuṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. gaṇitakena tīṇi.
patthana24.3:10.1: na hetuṃ na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nakenaciviññeyyaduke hetuduka kenaciviññeyyadukaṃ
patthana24.3:11.1: na hetuṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana24.3:12.1: na hetuṃ na kenacinaviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu kenacinaviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava. nahetudukanoāsavaduke hetuduka āsavadukaṃ
